title: Tidal Cavern Drift
description: A cavernous noise-sculpted pad built from brown noise that slowly journeys a resonant low-pass filter from a subterranean rumble up to a hissing full-spectrum shimmer and back. Vowel formants and a phaser breathe over a wet, panning reverb so the texture feels like alien wind moving through a vast wet cave.
code:
setcpm(120/4)
stack(
  s("brown").gain(0.85)
    .attack(2).decay(4).sustain(0.8).release(3)
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(180, 7000)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(6, 18)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(24).range(0.5, 3)).lpattack(2).lpdecay(6)
    .hpf(saw.slow(29).range(40, 300))
    .vowel("<a o u e>/4")
    .phaser(sine.slow(17).range(0.1, 0.6)).phaserdepth(0.7)
    .crush(sine.slow(19).range(16, 7))
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.15, 0.85))
    .room(0.9).roomsize(8).delay("0.4:0.5:0.7").orbit(2)
    .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(7)).gain(0.3).speed(sine.slow(23).range(0.9, 1.1)))
)
